name: Summer at Hopkins
description_short: Hopkins School's summer school in New Haven offers small academic and enrichment classes for students entering grades 5 to 12, from Hopkins and other schools. Classes run in two-hour blocks in the morning and early afternoon, and families pay per course.
activities: Academic courses for credit and enrichment

sources.note: Lower School dates; Middle School page gives the same June 22 to July 24 dates and Upper School June 22 to July 31
Course prices from $800 (D&D) to $1,250, $2,000 for two courses

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown (Summer School June 22–July 24, 2026), and it has already passed. No 2027 dates are posted yet.

This is an overview page covering three separate programs: Summer School, Pathfinder (open only to high-achieving grade 5–8 students from New Haven public and parochial schools; applications open in October) and Summer Athletics (run by outside partner organizations, not Hopkins). Each has its own page with details.
The single session recorded is the full Summer School window. Individual courses may have different dates and prices.
